ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Steelset reads heart rate, workouts and weight from Apple Health to match them to your logs and import them.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Steelset on Apple Watch saves strength workouts to Apple Health, just like the Workout app. The phone itself never writes to Health.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Steelset uses this permission to show more relevant ads. Without it you'll see generic ads - the app works the same.
